title: 3 Caraga drug suspects busted, almost P120,000 shabu seized

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Police arrested three drug suspects and seized nearly P120,000 worth of suspected “shabu” or crystal meth alongside an unlicensed firearm during separate entrapment operations across the Caraga region on Friday. Brig. Gen. Rolindo M. Suguilon, Police Regional Office 13 (PRO-13) director, said the coordinated operations with the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) spanned the provinces of Agusan del Sur, Surigao del Sur, and Agusan del Norte, yielding a total of P119,680 worth of illegal drugs. In San Francisco, Agusan del Sur, local police and PDEA operatives arrested 47-year-old alias “Richard” at Purok 2, Barangay Karaos. […]...
